remediation: Go to the AWS IAM console, find the user associated with this key, and click 'Make inactive' or 'Delete'. Then, generate a new key.
Go to GitHub -> Settings -> Developer settings -> Personal access tokens. Find this token and revoke it immediately.
Go to the GCP Console -> IAM & Admin -> Service Accounts. Find the service account, go to the 'Keys' tab, find the leaked Key ID, and delete it. Generate a new key and store it securely.
